newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI RICE PRICES SEEN MIXED ON LOW DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI RICE PRICES SEEN MIXED ON LOW DEMAND.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to remain mixed next week due to low buying interest abroad, dealers said on Thursday.

Prices of IRRI-6 variety remained stable this week as foreign buyers waited for the new crop expected in October, exporter Khalid Ghori said. Basmati super export prices remained steady and ordinary basmati edged up.
Pakistan exported 1.717 million tonnes of rice worth $460 million during 1996/97 (July-June), compared to 1.6 million tonnes worth $504 million in the same period a year ago.
In June, rice exports fell to 86,488 tonnes worth $28 million compared to 151,568 tonnes worth $39 million in May and 347,471 tonnes worth $93 million in June 1996.
